dict.Contractele firmei (clienți, furnizori,: The company's contracts (customers, suppliers, rent, insurance, subscriptions): the partner, the period, the value, automatic renewal and the notice period; the days left fill in by themselves, expired ones turn red, those due for renewal yellow.
dict.La Prelungire automată = Da, după sfârși: With Automatic renewal = Yes, the contract does not show as Expired after its end; write the new end date when you check it.
dict.Lasă Sfârșit gol la contractele pe perio: Leave End empty for open-ended contracts.
